Siding options for the Saunders Residence

Thank you to everyone who came out to the meeting. We believe we addressed several of the concerns neighbours raised when we first met at the Committee of Adjustment earlier this year. After our discussion last week at the library, we wanted to hear what you think of the facade and exterior of the building.

One of the main concerns was the colour of the building. Although there are examples of white homes in the neighbourhood, it isn't the preferred direction. So we walked the neighbourhood taking photos of the surrounding homes to see what would be a better fit.

Go through the three steps below to choose the window colour, add a stone look to the front, and pick the door colour and siding, whether vertical or horizontal. Then fill out the form at the bottom and send it to us so we can see what the neighbourhood prefers.

The DevCom team

Please note: the pictures below are virtual previews. We've done our best to show each option as accurately as we can, but colours and details won't be exact. They're meant to give a good sense of how each option would look and feel on the street.

Step 1

Which overall look do you prefer?

Black windows cost a bit more than white. If we go with white windows, we can put those savings toward a stone facade across the front of the building. Dark windows give the house its contrast on their own, while white windows look best balanced with stone, the same pairing used on many homes in the subdivision.

Step 2

Horizontal or vertical siding?

Horizontal boards run side to side like most homes nearby. Vertical board and batten has tall boards with narrow strips over the seams.

Step 3

Choose your siding preference
